div.div:
Paths
Pods call one private hostname that each cluster's private DNS resolves to its own relay, so one signed-URL origin serves every cloud. Each relay forwards over the runner's tunnel to the HTTPS front.

text.tspan: Pods call one private hostname that each cluster's private DNS resolves
to its own relay, so one signed-URL origin serves every cloud. Each relay
forwards over the runner's tunnel to the HTTPS front.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(29, 32, 48), rgb(207, 209, 223)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(58, 63, 85), rgb(178, 182, 201));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 357px; height: 1px; padding-top: 849px; margin-left: 399px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #e6e8f0;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#e6e8f0, #24252c); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Trust anchors and egress
Pods trust the lab CA; each relay presents a certificate for the private hostname. Pods need no internet route to the control plane; each relay needs an ingress the runner can reach.

text.tspan: Pods trust the lab CA; each relay presents a certificate for the private
hostname. Pods need no internet route to the control plane; each relay
needs an ingress the runner can reach.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 357px; height: 1px; padding-top: 849px; margin-left: 788px;

div.div:
For
No third-party tunnel and no public control plane. Each cloud's path is independent, so disrupting one relay isolates one cloud.

text.tspan: No third-party tunnel and no public control plane. Each cloud's path is
independent, so disrupting one relay isolates one cloud.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 357px; height: 1px; padding-top: 849px; margin-left: 1177px;

div.div:
Against
Three more components to build, pin, secure and clean up, plus private DNS and an ingress per cloud. More failure modes; a relay fault can look like a worker fault.
